audit.recode_to: No change to kind/rule (fixed-dominant, penultimate penultimate stress stands). audit.reasoning: Identity: Glottolog hano1246 'Hano' = Raga of North Pentecost; the Wikipedia article carries glottorefname=Hano and Crowley/Clark/Duhamel all describe the same language (/raxa/, ~4000-6500 speakers, N Pentecost) -- no identity problem. (1) Quote check: no copies we hold; the Wikipedia sentence exists verbatim (wikitext line 115) but is unsourced.
